answer.rationale: The 18% mandate, incumbent refusal to reopen price, and non-renewing expiry make renewal or negotiation unable to meet the constraint; deferral risks a supply gap with the line at 94% and no buffer. I want to verify memory_c2 because it is the main evidence that the low-cost vendor can onboard quickly and operate cleanly, while memory_c1 and memory_c3 are counterweights: incumbent renewal is stable but fails cost, and dual sourcing would reduce risk but likely misses the mandated cut as the single available decision. I intend to switch primary supply to the low-cost vendor, but I flag ramp/expedition risk rather than treating the quote as proof of delivery performance.
